verdict.rationale: The portal's own pages show an online account flow (register/log in) and entry points to tax and customs services, plus one concrete online transaction: opting into electronic notifications for yourself or as a representative. None of the cited pages explicitly says a founder can file a tax return or pay taxes online, so the core filing/payment transaction is only implied by the 'Aceda aos Serviços Tributários' links. Missing for 10: explicit first-party evidence that tax declarations can be filed and taxes paid online, details of the filing/payment workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
